title: Structured exchange profile v1
description: A project's data model, as structured-exchange documents must follow it: the kinds that exist, the attributes each kind carries, and the values each enumeration allows. Read from the project's own files and matched to a document by exact identifier; never fetched. Flat on purpose: profiles are built outside the application that applies them, and reviewed by hand.

id.description: The identifier a document names in its `profile` to be held to this profile. Compared as an exact string, never resolved.

label.description: What a reader calls this model.

description.description: Where the model comes from, for whoever reviews the profile.

elementKinds.description: The kinds graph elements and table rows may carry. A document held to this profile may use no other.

relationshipKinds.description: The kinds graph relationships and table relations may carry. A document held to this profile may use no other.

viewpoints.description: The readings this domain's models are made for, available to every document held to this profile. Same shape as a document's own viewpoints; the kinds they retain must be declared above.

kindDeclaration.description: One kind and the attributes an item of that kind may carry. An item may carry no attribute this does not declare.

relationshipKindDeclaration.description: One relationship kind, the attributes a relationship of that kind may carry, and optionally the element kinds it may join. A side left undeclared allows any element kind. Declaring ends is newer than the format's first release: a profile that declares them is refused by a validator or an application that predates them.

from.description: The element kinds allowed at the source. A relationship whose source is an item of another kind is refused.

to.description: The element kinds allowed at the target. A relationship whose target is an item of another kind is refused.

attribute.description: One attribute of a kind. An enumeration lists its values and says whether they are the only ones allowed (closed) or the known ones (open); no other type carries values.

required.description: An item of this kind must carry a value for it. Null is not a value. Enforced on complete documents; a proposal is refused only for removing it.

list.description: The value is a list of this type rather than one value.

values.description: An enumeration's values, in the order a reviewer should read them.

closed.description: True: a value outside `values` is refused. False: it is accepted and reported.

viewpoint.description: A named reading, as a version 2 document declares one.
